Title: Allow users to sign up and sign in using email and password.
Details: The system must validate credentials and manage sessions securely.
Overview: Enables users to authenticate using email and password credentials.

Title: User authentication and account access.
Details: Includes registration, login and password recovery flows.
Overview: Ensures secure and seamless user login and account management.

Title: Implement third-party authentication with Google and GitHub.
Details: Integrate Google and GitHub OAuth with the existing user store.
Overview: Adds OAuth based sign in for faster onboarding.

Title: Password recovery via email OTP.
Details: Send a one time code to the registered email to reset the password.
Overview: Lets users reset a forgotten password securely.

Title: Enable multi-factor authentication for admin users.
Details: Prompt for a second factor when an admin signs in.
Overview: Adds an extra security layer for privileged accounts.
